messages:
alex.t: Quick thread: propose we treat streaming chat as ordered delta stream with session id + seq numbers; clients responsible for at-least-once vs exactly-once? prefer monotonic seq for dedupe. Also propose explicit 'complete' and 'interrupt' finish reasons. @dana @matthew thoughts?

Dana: I like session+seq. question: how does this interact with SSE where reconnects are common? need resume token.

matthew: SSE can include Last-Event-ID header; but mobile proxies drop it. Alternate: server-issued resume_token in initial event, appended to deltas. on reconnect client sends resume_token.

alex.t: Good point about proxies. Maybe simpler: make delta envelope include 'session_id' and 'offset'. client on reconnect sends last-seen offset. Server must be able to re-stream from offset, but for ephemeral KV we can't guarantee older cache. fallback: server sends 'resumption_unavailable' finish reason.

jia: can we standardize finish reasons: completed, cancelled_by_user, model_truncated, resumption_unavailable, error_rate_limited, fallback_served? keep short codes.

matthew: +1, but 'fallback_served' ambiguous. maybe 'fallback_served'. Also need explicit 'partial' attribute when we stream best-effort snippet and then stop.

alex.t: For API surface, propose two modes: resumable (needs server-side retention + resume_token) and stateless streaming (no resumption, cheaper). Clients pick via param streaming_resume=true/false.

Dana: Launch criteria: resumable must handle 99th percentile reconnect within 30s, retention default 60s, configurable up to 5m. ops: storage/cost impact TBD.

ops-bot: deploy note: will add metric streaming.resumption.requests and streaming.resumption.failures.

matthew: Implementation note: deltas will be newline-delimited JSON with envelope: {"session_id":"...","seq":123,"delta":"...","finish_reason":"..."}. Examples?

alex.t: Example payload:
```
data: {"session_id":"s_abc","seq":12,"delta":"world","finish_reason":"none"}
```

jia: UX: SDKs should provide auto-reconnect with exponential backoff and a callback for resume outcome (success/fallback). Document behavior for SSE vs WS.

Dana: ok I'll draft product PR with acceptance criteria and perf targets. tagging @eng-runtime for feasibility check.

eng-runtime: FYI checking memory impact of 60s retention for 100k sessions; will follow up.

alex.t: thanks. if no objections, aim for experiment in next sprint. :rocket:
